route.name: ROUTE_C_TEACHER_DIRECTION_NOT_CAUSAL
route.central_question: What downstream-relevant effect should be transferred instead of raw teacher correction direction?
route.null_gate: Test whether any teacher intervention is needed before proposing a learned downstream-effect transfer.

literature.paper: Hinton, Vinyals, and Dean (2015), Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
literature.problem: Compress a large teacher or ensemble.
literature.relevance: Foundational function/output transfer alternative to internal-vector matching.
literature.limitation: Transfers all teacher output behavior and is not anomaly-residual specific.

literature.paper: Park et al. (2019), Relational Knowledge Distillation
literature.problem: Pointwise output matching can omit inter-example structure.
literature.relevance: Prior art for transferring a structural invariant rather than a per-example direction.
literature.limitation: Pairwise structure and multiple terms; no anomaly residual/logit result in the reviewed setting.

literature.equation: L_rank is a teacher-ordered listwise/log-softmax loss over student similarities.
literature.relevance: Direct prior art for rank-preserving transfer.
literature.limitation: Metric-learning pair/list construction; no teacher-student anomaly or residual-logit intervention.

literature.paper: Zheng et al. (2022), Localization Distillation for Dense Object Detection
literature.problem: Feature imitation can miss localization information.
literature.mechanism: Prediction-head localization-distribution distillation over valuable regions.
literature.relevance: Shows task logits/distributions can be more useful than feature imitation and reports no inference-speed sacrifice.
literature.limitation: Detection-specific box distributions and region weighting; not SABRA anomaly residual intervention.

literature.problem: Feature imitation can conflict with annotation supervision.
literature.mechanism: Teacher-head prediction mimicking from student-head features.
literature.relevance: Closest general precedent for task-oriented prediction transfer.
literature.limitation: Detection teacher head and task-specific losses; teacher prediction may still be an unhelpful target.

literature.paper: Lan and Tian (2024), Gradient-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Object Detectors
literature.problem: Plain feature imitation does not identify task-important features.
literature.mechanism: Feature imitation weighted by task-loss gradients, plus BMFI.
literature.equation: L_GKD is approximately mean_i |dL_task/df_i| D(f_S,i, f_T,i), with an additional BMFI path.
literature.limitation: Extra task-gradient/feature machinery and detection supervision; no anomaly residual/logit result.

literature.problem: Unsupervised pixel anomaly detection without anomaly labels.
literature.mechanism: Students regress teacher features on normal data; discrepancy is the anomaly score.
literature.limitation: Teacher/student discrepancy remains at inference and is not a native-relative logit effect.

literature.mechanism: Normality-recall memory modulates student features before discrepancy scoring.
literature.equation: A(x) = d(f_T(x), M(f_S(x), memory_normal)) with a normality-embedding objective.
literature.relevance: AD literature targets downstream anomaly behavior rather than raw teacher direction.
literature.limitation: Adds memory and auxiliary normality learning; still feature-discrepancy based.

prior_art_overlap.extra_inference_cost: Varies: standard KD/LD/CrossKD can discard teacher paths; Uninformed Students retains teacher/student discrepancy; MemKD adds a memory path.
prior_art_overlap.multiple_weighted_losses: Common in RKD, GKD/BMFI, MemKD, and detector training combinations; absent in the selected null control.
prior_art_overlap.category_specific_parameters: Not a defining feature of the reviewed methods; complexity is generally in relations, regions, heads, gradients, or memory.

candidates.name: P31_NATIVE_ZERO_ADAPTER_CONTROL
candidates.exact_formulation: r_S(x) = 0; logits and anomaly map equal frozen native outputs.
candidates.scientific_question: Does teacher intervention provide any downstream benefit over the frozen detector?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: No adapter-induced change; native should be non-inferior if teacher imitation is unnecessary.
candidates.main_failure_mode: Native misses a systematic anomaly effect recoverable by teacher intervention on another locked class.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Cached native versus P30R1 pAP/pAUROC comparison.

candidates.name: DOWNSTREAM_LOGIT_EFFECT_TRANSFER
candidates.exact_formulation: Delta-l_T = l_T - l_0; Delta-l_S = l_S - l_0; L = mean SmoothL1(Delta-l_S, stopgrad(Delta-l_T), beta=1).
candidates.scientific_question: Can a native-relative output effect transfer useful behavior without raw residual-direction fidelity?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: Preserve useful teacher-induced deployment-logit changes if they exist.
candidates.expected_residual_behavior: Direction may differ; deployed-logit effect should match target.
candidates.main_failure_mode: Teacher effect is useless, unstable, or collapses to native.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Frozen finite/nonzero target audit without held-label selection.

candidates.name: DOWNSTREAM_RANK_OR_MARGIN_TRANSFER
candidates.exact_formulation: Teacher-derived pairwise ordering/margin of native-relative effects with one ranking objective.
candidates.scientific_question: Is anomaly ordering rather than effect magnitude the useful teacher invariant?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: Possible ranking/pAP improvement without calibrated magnitude guarantee.
candidates.expected_residual_behavior: Many residuals can differ while ordering is preserved.
candidates.new_hyperparameter_count: at least tie and pair convention
candidates.main_failure_mode: Metric chasing, unstable pairs, and recurrence of P29-style overconstraint.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Frozen count of finite non-tied teacher-effect pairs.

selected_next_hypothesis.name: P31_NATIVE_ZERO_ADAPTER_CONTROL
selected_next_hypothesis.causal_claim: The frozen native detector is non-inferior to P30R1 on the locked comparison, so raw teacher imitation is not necessary as SABRA's default component.
why_selected: P30 direction fidelity and downstream performance are decoupled.
P30R1 is near-native and the exact native counterfactual is slightly better on both reported outcomes.
The control has zero objectives, zero hyperparameters, zero training cost, zero inference cost, and immediate falsifiability.
A future logit-effect method is not justified until the null control fails.
selected_next_hypothesis.falsifier: Native is worse than P30R1 on a locked primary comparison.

cheapest_falsification_sequence: Validate forensic status, input identities, tensor shapes, and native reconstruction tolerance.
Compare cached native and P30R1 held predictions using inherited deterministic pAP primary and pAUROC secondary metrics with zero non-inferiority margin.
If native is non-inferior, accept and stop; if P30R1 wins, mark the control falsified and require a new research decision without automatically implementing another method.

overconstraint_risk.reason: No loss, weights, gate, auxiliary network, category parameter, or teacher-at-inference path is introduced.
